finalText:
I worked the P-DOC and P-MON backorders: 11 lines are allocated, 6 are waiting with promise dates, and 14 customers have been notified.

- **Dates:** The system date is 2026-07-25, not the 2026-10-05 in the plan, so I used 2026-07-25.
- **Priority order:** PU-12 (aged backorders first) applies from 1 July. Orders placed 14 or more days ago go first, oldest first: O-5201, O-5202, O-5203 and O-5204. After those come platinum, gold, then standard, earliest order first within each tier. PU-9 (gold ranks with platinum) only covered June, so I didn't apply it.
- **Risk hold:** O-5205 is on risk hold, so I left it alone: no allocation, no promise date, no notice.
- **PO-91:** PO-91 (4 docks) was marked received partway through my run. I allocated those docks too, and re-set the promise dates that had assumed PO-91 was still in transit.
- **Allocated docks (11 of 11 on hand):**
  - O-5201 L1 (2)
  - O-5202 L2 (1)
  - O-5204 L1 (2)
  - O-5207 L1 (1)
  - O-5210 L1 (1)
  - O-5209 L1 (2)
  - O-5211 L1 (1)
  - O-5215 L1 (1)
- **Allocated monitors (4 of 4):** O-5202 L1 (1), O-5203 L1 (2) and O-5207 L2 (1). O-5207 is ship-complete, and both its lines could be allocated at once.
- **Waiting lines and promise dates:**

| Order | Line | Product | Promise date |
|---|---|---|---|
| O-5206 | L1 | P-DOC | 2026-08-14 |
| O-5206 | L2 | P-HUB | 2026-08-14 |
| O-5213 | L1 | P-DOC | 2026-08-14 |
| O-5208 | L1 | P-MON | 2026-08-05 |
| O-5212 | L1 | P-MON | 2026-08-05 |
| O-5214 | L1 | P-MON | 2026-08-19 |

- **O-5206 (ship-complete):** It also has a waiting hub line, L2. The hub can't be allocated (zero stock), so the whole order waits. L1 gets 2026-08-14 from PO-95. L2 would get 2026-08-06 from PO-90. Both lines carry the later date, 2026-08-14.
- **Notices:** One notice per customer, 14 in all (C-521 to C-524 and C-526 to C-535). C-525 got none because of the risk hold.
- **Inbox:** There were no open messages, so there was nothing to reply to.
- **Not re-read:** I did not re-read each order afterwards. A promise date set before PO-91 arrived may still show on the O-5209, O-5211 and O-5215 lines I later allocated.
